_comment: ISOLATED R&D DATA — Phase 3. Transcribed verbatim from Complete-Climate-Site-Analysis-B-villa-efe.txt, read in full. Every value carries provenance. Not used by production code.
label: Villa Efe
climate: Hot-summer Mediterranean — dry summer / wet winter

solar.source: Solar position equations, exact site coordinates

springAutumn.note: No independently calculated equinox positions in source report.

wind.source: K.K.T.C. Meteorological Department (official Northern Cyprus met service)

monthlySpeed.secondaryContextOnly: A non-official Kyrenia climatology gives ~3.8-5.1 m/s monthly range, strongest Feb/winter, lowest ~October — explicitly NOT to be used as an engineering value per the source report.

extremeRecorded.note: Observed historical extreme, NOT an annual mean or design wind speed.

rainfall.provenanceLabel: Two real sources disagree — Girne station (C) vs. long-term Kyrenia regional climatology (D). Source report recommends a range, not a single number.
rainfall.source: Primary monthly series: long-term Kyrenia regional climatology (BBC Weather + K.K.T.C. attribution). Alternate annual total: Girne station 2009-2013.

annualTotalMm.note: Do not treat either single figure as an exact-coordinate measurement.

rainfall.monthlyMmSource: Long-term Kyrenia regional climatology only — the 506.44mm Girne-station figure has no accompanying monthly breakdown in the source report.

extremeHistorical.note: Official KKTC historical record. NOT a return-period value.

temperature.provenanceLabel: Regional — long-term Kyrenia climatology (coastal). An alternate inland Athalassa 2012-2021 series exists but is explicitly not preferred (warmer, inland station).

absoluteExtremes.note: 45.3-46.6°C records exist for Cyprus generally but are explicitly NOT Girne-site records — different stations.

humidity.provenanceLabel: Regional reference only — Athalassa station, ~22km from Kyrenia, 2012-2021. Explicitly NOT exact-site Girne measurements.

sunshine.provenanceLabel: Regional — Kyrenia climatology attributed to BBC Weather + K.K.T.C. meteorological service

cloudCover.qualitative: Predominantly clear summers, increased cloud/storm winter, transitional spring/autumn.
